visual_description: Dusty Sal, a gruff but fair saloon owner. Stocky build, dark flat-brimmed hat, brown vest over a tan shirt, tan trousers, dark worn boots. Front-facing standing idle pose.
silhouette_description: Wide hat brim at the top, round head, boxy torso wider than the head, two short legs. Arms are a SEPARATE layer (see arm_*.json specs) — this body layer should have short shoulder stubs only, no full arms, so arm layers attach cleanly at the same shoulder position.

generation_prompt.subject: middle-aged stocky saloon-keeper character, gruff expression implied by posture (do NOT render facial features — face is added separately)
generation_prompt.composition: full-body, centered, front-facing, standing idle pose, isolated on plain/transparent background
generation_prompt.silhouette: wide-brimmed dark hat, broad shoulders, boxy vest torso, sturdy legs, worn boots
generation_prompt.clothing: dark brown flat-topped hat, brown leather vest over tan shirt, tan trousers, dark leather boots
generation_prompt.lighting: soft light from upper-left, flat/stylized shading, no harsh photorealistic shadows
generation_prompt.visual_language: stylized low-poly-adjacent game character concept, clean simple shapes, strong readable silhouette, NOT photorealistic
generation_prompt.requirements: isolated subject, plain or transparent background, no text, no watermark, no face detail (blank/featureless head), no full arms (shoulder stubs only)

negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, photorealistic, extra limbs, malformed hands, multiple characters, background clutter, detailed face, gradients, blurry edges, duplicate objects
source_reference: assets/_legacy/sprites/body_dusty_sal.png (procedurally hand-authored placeholder this asset replaces)
notes: Status becomes 'generated' once a concept image lands in assets/_incoming/dusty_sal_body/source.png and tools/pixel-art/process.py has produced an assets/generated/ candidate; 'approved' once a human picks a version to promote into assets/approved/ and then src/assets/sprites/.
